description: This line plot illustrates the loss values across iterations for four different training configurations of the SepLLM model and a baseline Vanilla model, with the loss decreasing over time for all configurations. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 iterations with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals of 5,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.0 to 2.8 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines: a magenta line with circular markers and a solid line, representing “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, which starts at a loss of approximately 2.9 and decreases to about 2.2; a blue line with circular markers and a solid line, representing “SepLLM (n=128)”, which begins at a loss of approximately 2.9 and declines to about 2.3; an orange line with circular markers and a solid line, representing “SepLLM (n=64)”, which starts at a loss of approximately 2.9 and ends at about 2.3; and a red dashed line with circular markers, representing “Vanilla before post-training”, which remains constant at a loss value of approximately 2.35 throughout the entire iteration range.
